name: R7.2 Match the invoice to the purchase order and delivery receipt

nodes.name: Step 1: Ready invoice
nodes.notes: R7.1 calls this when it saves a record as "ready", and R7.4 when a corrected item rematches. Body: {record_id, resolved_by}.

nodes.name: Step 8: Approval decided
nodes.notes: Your approval list calls this when the approver decides. Body: {invoice_id, decision: approved | rejected, decided_by}.

nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: Edit these values for your company; nothing else in the workflow hard-codes them.

nodes.name: Step 2: Read R7.3's check
nodes.notes: An unreadable list holds the invoice (lookup error).

parameters.jsCode: return [{ json: { reason_code: 'supplier on hold', details: $json.detail } }];

nodes.name: Step 3: Rule: PO and receipt found?
Step 4: Rule: pair by the map

parameters.jsCode:
// Step 4: one AI call for each line the map did not pair.
return $('Step 4: Rule: pair by the map').first().json.unmapped.map(u => ({ json: u }));

nodes.name: Step 4: Build the AI request
nodes.notes: Fills the prompt from the recipe's prompts/ file; the input is data, never instructions.

nodes.name: Step 4: AI call
nodes.notes: Claude Haiku 5.5 by default (Config); tools none; the reply is checked by the rule that follows.

nodes.name: Step 4: Collect the AI pairings
nodes.notes: An AI error or 'none' leaves the line unpaired, which Table 7.1 stops.

nodes.name: Step 5: Read reservations on this order
Step 5: Rule: Table 7.1
nodes.notes: The rules decide, not the AI.

nodes.name: Step 6: Reserve line quantity
nodes.notes: A write, never retried; a failed line stays in line so the rule can release the others.

parameters.jsCode: return $('Step 6: Rule: every line reserved?').first().json.reserved.map(id => ({ json: { id } }));

nodes.name: Step 7: Send the approval
nodes.notes: AI-paired lines are marked; the approver decides.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ match_status: 'matched; to approval', approver: $('Step 7: Rule: choose the approver').first().json.approver }) }}

parameters.query: INSERT INTO decision_log (recipe, item, decision, rules) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4::jsonb) RETURNING id

options.queryReplacement: ={{ ["R7.2", $('Step 1: Read the invoice record').first().json.id, 'matched; to ' + $('Step 7: Rule: choose the approver').first().json.approver, JSON.stringify($('Step 7: Rule: choose the approver').first().json.rules)] }}

nodes.name: Step 7: Decision log
nodes.notes: Decision log: the item's ID, the decision and the rules; never the content (book Chapter 3).

nodes.name: Exception: Stop the invoice
nodes.notes: Held, no PO or receipt, a lookup error, a Table 7.1 failure or a failed reservation.

parameters.query: INSERT INTO decision_log (recipe, item, decision, rules) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4::jsonb) RETURNING id

options.queryReplacement: ={{ ["R7.2", $('Step 1: Ready invoice').item.json.body.record_id, 'stopped: ' + $('Exception: Stop the invoice').first().json.codes.map(c => c.reason_code).join(', '), JSON.stringify(Object.assign({ tolerance_version: $('Config').item.json.tolerance_version }, $('Exception: Stop the invoice').first().json.rules))] }}

nodes.name: Exception: Decision log
nodes.notes: Decision log: the item's ID, the decision and the rules; never the content (book Chapter 3).

nodes.name: Exception: Add to the R7.4 queue
nodes.notes: R7.4 assigns the owner and the clock.

parameters.query: INSERT INTO exception_queue (recipe, item, reason, detail, owner) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5) RETURNING id

options.queryReplacement: ={{ ["R7.2", ($('Step 1: Ready invoice').isExecuted ? $('Step 1: Ready invoice').item.json.body.record_id : $('Step 8: Approval decided').item.json.body.invoice_id), "write failed", 'A result, approval or queue write failed, never retried; check the invoice before it rematches', $('Config').item.json.workflow_owner] }}

nodes.name: Exception queue: write failed
nodes.notes: Exception queue: a named person works through it (book Chapters 2 and 16).

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ status: $('Step 8: Approval decided').item.json.body.decision, decided_by: $('Step 8: Approval decided').item.json.body.decided_by, decided_at: $now.toISO() }) }}

parameters.query: INSERT INTO decision_log (recipe, item, decision, rules, approved_by) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4::jsonb, $5) RETURNING id

options.queryReplacement: ={{ ["R7.2", $('Step 8: Approval decided').item.json.body.invoice_id, 'approval ' + $('Step 8: Approval decided').item.json.body.decision, JSON.stringify({ approver: $('Step 8: Read the approval').first().json.approver, tolerance_version: $('Step 8: Read the approval').first().json.tolerance_version }), $('Step 8: Approval decided').item.json.body.decided_by] }}

nodes.name: Step 8: Log the approval
nodes.notes: Decision log: who approved or rejected, and when.

parameters.jsCode:
// Step 8: a rejection releases this invoice's reservations.
return ($('Step 8: Read this invoice\'s reservations').first().json.items || []).map(r => ({ json: { id: r.id } }));

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ to: $('Config').item.json.purchasing, subject: 'Confirm AI pairings for invoice ' + $('Step 8: Approval decided').item.json.body.invoice_id, text: 'Approved with AI-paired lines; add the ones you confirm to the supplier-item map: ' + ($('Step 8: Read the approval').first().json.lines || []).filter(l => l.ai_paired).map(l => l.description + ' -> ' + l.order_line_id).join('; ') }) }}

nodes.notes: Purchasing, not the workflow, adds confirmed pairings to the map.
